message.orevault.entry_point_none: No Vault entry points set yet. Right-click a block inside your Vault.
orevault.configuration.title: Ore Vault
orevault.configuration.resonance.target_: Hours of hand-mining that should make the whole Resonance tree purchasable. Read once at server start; changing it needs a restart.
orevault.configuration.resonance.curve_d: Scales the whole grind without changing the curve's shape. 2.0 halves it, 0.5 doubles it. Every skill-tree level requirement keeps its intended pacing. Needs a restart.
orevault.configuration.chunk_loading.vau: Whether the Vault Presence nodes work at all. Off disables cross-dimension chunk loading entirely.
orevault.configuration.chunk_loading.max: Hard ceiling on chunks one team can keep loaded, whatever their node level says. 0 means unlimited, which is not recommended.
orevault.configuration.ore_classificatio: Force a rarity for specific ore blocks instead of letting the classifier decide. Format: modid:block_id=common|uncommon|rare
orevault.configuration.disturbed_zones.m: How many Disturbed Zone blocks one team may place. Post-1.0 feature; the setting is inert until it ships.
orevault.configuration.reset.allow_backu: Whether a team may export a copy of their Vault before resetting it. Turn off if disk space is tight.
orevault.configuration.debug.enable_debu: Unlocks /orevault diag and /orevault testore, which overwrites terrain with ore. Operator permission is still required. Playtest tooling — leave off for normal play.
orevault.configuration.debug.log_resonan: Print a chat line each time an orb pays Resonance, showing the pool, level and progress. The only readout of the pool until the Tome exists.
